body:
With NX8's 8-bit static formats, the tensor that loses most even in its best format is layernorm output in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256: 32.1 dB SQNR (signal-to-quantization-noise ratio; higher is better) in fp8_e2m5, measured on that tensor alone by the format search. Measured on 23 models with a format search (of 289 surveyed).

Model outputs keep a median 24.4 dB SQNR against full precision, the worst 5.0 dB (Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B). 14 of 19 models with a prediction metric (top-1, perplexity or agreement) lose some of it; the most: microsoft/table-transformer-structure-recognition (agreement 100% → 0%: the share of samples whose predicted class matches full precision's), PaddlePaddle/PP-DocLayoutV3_safetensors (agreement 100% → 0%: the share of samples whose predicted class matches full precision's) and Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B (perplexity 35.1 → 68.6, higher is worse).

The tensors that lose most in their best format (their own error): layernorm output in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 (fp8_e2m5, 32.1 dB), linear bias in deepset/roberta-base-squad2 (fp8_e2m5, 33.6 dB), linear bias in facebook/bart-large-cnn (fp8_e2m5, 33.9 dB), add output in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 (fp8_e2m5, 34.0 dB), embedding output in BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 (fp8_e2m5, 34.1 dB), linear output in deepset/roberta-base-squad2 (fp8_e3m4, 34.1 dB), layernorm bias in jonatasgrosman/wav2vec2-large-xlsr-53-japanese (fp8_e3m4, 34.2 dB), layernorm bias in BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-m3 (fp8_e2m5, 34.4 dB), mul output in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 (fp8_e2m5, 34.5 dB) and layernorm bias in openai-community/gpt2 (fp8_e3m4, 34.5 dB).

Separately, the error accumulated along the data path (every tensor before a node quantized too): reciprocal outputs end furthest from full precision, PekingU/rtdetr_r101vd_coco_o365 keeping only -inf dB there. The outputs furthest from full precision in each model's best format set: reciprocal in PekingU/rtdetr_r101vd_coco_o365 (fp8_e3m4, -inf dB), mul in PekingU/rtdetr_r101vd_coco_o365 (fp8_e3m4, -inf dB), div in PekingU/rtdetr_r101vd_coco_o365 (fp8_e3m4, -inf dB), log in PekingU/rtdetr_r101vd_coco_o365 (fp8_e3m4, -inf dB), div in microsoft/table-transformer-structure-recognition (fp8_e3m4, -inf dB), reciprocal in PaddlePaddle/PP-DocLayoutV3_safetensors (fp8_e3m4, -inf dB), mul in PaddlePaddle/PP-DocLayoutV3_safetensors (fp8_e3m4, -inf dB), div in PaddlePaddle/PP-DocLayoutV3_safetensors (fp8_e3m4, -inf dB), log in PaddlePaddle/PP-DocLayoutV3_safetensors (fp8_e3m4, -inf dB) and amin in PaddlePaddle/PP-DocLayoutV3_safetensors (fp8_e3m4, -758.2 dB, with full precision's selection forced).

Formats chosen (E = exponent bits, M = mantissa bits, u = unsigned): fp8_e2m5 7625 (48%), fp8_e3m4 6540 (41%), fp8_e1m6 1657 (10%), fp8_e4m3 1 (under 0.01%); 0% of tensors use an unsigned format.

A wider format or a per-row choice would recover most where a tensor's own error in its format, times its data, is largest: silu output in stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5:vae (fp8_e2m5, 42.4 dB), conv2d weight in stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5:vae (fp8_e2m5, 42.7 dB) and conv2d bias in stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5:vae (fp8_e2m5, 43.2 dB).

body:
6 missing capabilities keep 83 operations in 9 models (of 19 planned) off the chip's direct path; the most widespread is run-time addressing (a load from an address computed on chip) (45 operations in 8 models). In two sections, each ranked by the MACs its gaps hold:

### Substitute proposed or evaluated (2 gaps)

**Run-time addressing (a load from an address computed on chip).** The chip cannot read memory at an address computed at run time, so every lookup or choice by a run-time value (embedding and gather) needs a workaround. It affects 45 operations in 8 models: 45 calls (0.67% of all calls) and no MACs (data movement only); the biggest: embedding in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256, gather in PekingU/rtdetr_r101vd_coco_o365 and embedding in BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-m3. Cost today: 1 of 45 have a workaround (1 exact, 0 approximate), 1 failed and 43 wait for one; 17 workarounds proposed, 8 passing its check, 9 evaluated on a model; the workarounds lose no measurable accuracy (0.00 dB of model output SQNR, measured on 1 operation); cycles not measured yet; 0 extra kernels.

**An integer format for indices.** No NX8 format can hold an integer index computed from the input, so the operations reading one (add, gather and repeat) need a workaround. It affects 9 operations in 4 models: 9 calls (0.13% of all calls) and no MACs (data movement only); the biggest: repeat in PekingU/rtdetr_r101vd_coco_o365, add in BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-m3 and gather in BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-m3. Cost today: 0 of 9 have a workaround (0 exact, 0 approximate), 1 failed and 8 wait for one; 3 workarounds proposed, 0 passing its check, 3 evaluated on a model; accuracy not measured yet; cycles not measured yet; 0 extra kernels.

### Found by the plan, not yet tried (4 gaps)

**Overlapping writes (col2im).** The chip cannot add overlapping outputs into memory (col2im), so conv_transpose2d need a workaround. It affects 2 operations in 1 model: 2 calls (0.03% of all calls) and 189 M MACs (under 0.01% of all MACs); the biggest: conv_transpose2d in depth-anything/Depth-Anything-V2-Small-hf. Cost today: 0 of 2 have a workaround (0 exact, 0 approximate), 0 failed and 2 wait for one; 0 workarounds proposed, 0 passing its check, none evaluated on a model; accuracy not measured yet; cycles not measured yet; 0 extra kernels.

**An aten::grid_sampler instruction.** The chip has no instruction for aten::grid_sampler, so every aten::grid_sampler needs a workaround. It affects 18 operations in 1 model: 18 calls (0.27% of all calls) and MACs not counted (the capture does not size an ATen op); the biggest: aten::grid_sampler in PekingU/rtdetr_r101vd_coco_o365. Cost today: 0 of 18 have a workaround (0 exact, 0 approximate), 0 failed and 18 wait for one; 0 workarounds proposed, 0 passing its check, none evaluated on a model; accuracy not measured yet; cycles not measured yet; 0 extra kernels.

**An upsample instruction.** The chip has no instruction for upsample, so every upsample needs a workaround. It affects 5 operations in 1 model: 5 calls (0.07% of all calls) and no MACs (data movement only); the biggest: upsample in depth-anything/Depth-Anything-V2-Small-hf. Cost today: 0 of 5 have a workaround (0 exact, 0 approximate), 0 failed and 5 wait for one; 0 workarounds proposed, 0 passing its check, none evaluated on a model; accuracy not measured yet; cycles not measured yet; 0 extra kernels.

**An aten::concat instruction.** The chip has no instruction for aten::concat, so every aten::concat needs a workaround. title: Missing instructions: 83 operations in 9 models need workarounds

body:
A kernel reads a tensor in the arrangement its writer stored it in; when the reader needs another arrangement, the reading kernel has to rearrange the data itself. This happens to 1017 of 1798 tensors passed between kernels (57%) in 18 models: 794 for attention heads split or merged, 202 for other reshapes, 18 for pixels reordered and 3 for image patches.

The reading operations are 670 operations (670 calls, 10% of all calls; 95.5 G MACs, 3.53% of all MACs). The most common causes (writer → reader): linear → bmm (attention heads split or merged) 565, linear → attention (attention heads split or merged) 207 and linear → add (other reshapes) 58; most in facebook/DiT-XL-2-256 (196), stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5 (128) and jonatasgrosman/wav2vec2-large-xlsr-53-japanese (88).

Cost today: extra cycles not measured yet (no reading kernel has run); 0 links fail.
title: Layout conversions: 1017 of 1798 tensors between kernels are rearranged

body:
Activations with no built-in function at the store (GELU, SiLU, tanh, …) go through a 256-entry lookup table (LUT), which limits their precision: 590 operations in 19 models (590 calls, 8.82% of all calls), most often silu (234), gelu (188) and sin (40). Their quantized accuracy: worst -inf dB SQNR over 530 measured operations.

Kernels per forward pass (host launches, one per planned kernel call): median 14, most 235 (PekingU/rtdetr_r101vd_coco_o365, 235 planned groups), over 19 models.

FP32 headroom (how far the largest value is from FP32 overflow, in powers of ten) is least at 33.4 powers of ten for bmm in jonatasgrosman/wav2vec2-large-xlsr-53-japanese (largest value 1.35e+05).

26 outputs in 2 models hold a value at the FP32 limit itself (mostly add (24) and select_where (2), e.g. an attention mask's fill value); they are counted apart from the headroom.

4 accuracy runs produced non-finite outputs (overflow or NaN).

0 kernels use over 80% of the 1,024-word instruction memory (IMEM) bank, of 4 kernels measured.
title: Resource limits: 590 operations limited by the LUT and up to 235 kernel launches per pass

body:
1. **Accuracy is the clearest measured cost:** NX8 causes some prediction-metric loss in 6 of 8 measured models; the largest reported drops are DiT token agreement from 100% to 64%, Stable Diffusion VAE to 68%, and RT-DETR to 78%. Model-output SQNR has a 25.6 dB median and a 12.7 dB worst case; LUT-limited activations reach −∞ dB SQNR in the worst measured operation, and two accuracy runs produced non-finite outputs.
2. **Cycles and throughput costs are largely unmeasured:** unary and binary MAC utilisation is 0% in the measured cases, but no cycle breakdown is available. Layout rearrangements affect 608 of 1,130 inter-kernel tensors (54%), across 403 operations and 84.5 G MACs; their extra cycles have not been measured. Planned launches range from a median of 13 to 235 per forward pass.
3. **Missing instructions leave 58 operations in 3 models without workarounds:** runtime addressing accounts for 33 calls, grid_sampler for 18, concat for 4, and integer indices for 3. None has a measured accuracy or cycle cost; adding the capabilities would put those operations directly on chip.
4. **Extra-kernel costs are not yet demonstrated:** no extra kernels are reported for the missing-operation workarounds, and no layout-reading kernel has run yet. Thus the findings quantify substantial accuracy risks and coverage/layout burdens, but do not yet establish their cycle or extra-kernel cost.
title: Agent summary

body:
**Overlapping writes (col2im)** would put 2 operations in 1 model on the chip directly, with no workaround: 2 calls (0.03% of all calls) and 189 M MACs (under 0.01% of all MACs); the accuracy it would recover is not measured yet (no workaround evaluated).

**Run-time addressing (a load from an address computed on chip)** would put 45 operations in 8 models on the chip directly, with no workaround: 45 calls (0.67% of all calls) and no MACs (they only move data); recovering 0.00 dB of model output SQNR measured on 1 workaround.

**An aten::grid_sampler instruction** would put 18 operations in 1 model on the chip directly, with no workaround: 18 calls (0.27% of all calls) and MACs not counted (the capture does not size an ATen op); the accuracy it would recover is not measured yet (no workaround evaluated).

**An integer format for indices** would put 9 operations in 4 models on the chip directly, with no workaround: 9 calls (0.13% of all calls) and no MACs (they only move data); the accuracy it would recover is not measured yet (no workaround evaluated).

**An upsample instruction** would put 5 operations in 1 model on the chip directly, with no workaround: 5 calls (0.07% of all calls) and no MACs (they only move data); the accuracy it would recover is not measured yet (no workaround evaluated).

**An aten::concat instruction** would put 4 operations in 1 model on the chip directly, with no workaround: 4 calls (0.06% of all calls) and MACs not counted (the capture does not size an ATen op); the accuracy it would recover is not measured yet (no workaround evaluated).
